claim_boundary: Read-only exploratory benchmark over public pull-request metadata and exact-head workflow observations. It may measure first-run completion, diagnostic specificity, actionable-message coverage, observed GitHub contrast, and historical-review concordance. Without enrolled users it cannot establish actual decision change, alert acceptance, retention, willingness to pay, defect prevention, or production readiness.

sampling.paired_attrition: If either repository in a pair has no eligible PR, exclude the whole pair. Do not substitute after observing AOS output.
pr_selection: Take the most recently updated open, non-draft pull request whose author is not classified as a bot and whose exact head SHA has at least one visible pull-request workflow run.
If no open PR is eligible, take the most recently merged non-bot pull request since 2026-05-01 with an exact head SHA and at least one visible pull-request workflow run.
Inspect at most the first 20 candidates in GitHub updated-descending order.
Do not filter on AOS verdict, check conclusion, review outcome, or changed paths.

cohorts.polish_definition: Repository maintained by an organization whose official material identifies a Polish registered office, headquarters, or founding location. Individual nationality and comment language are not used.

comparators.definition: Observed GitHub merge/check baseline for the exact head SHA.
Decision from required check state without AOS policy context or replay evidence.
WARN when any visible check is not success, without requiredness or skip semantics.

metrics.first_run_completion_rate: case returns a bounded diagnosis and evidence within 300 seconds
metrics.exact_sha_binding_rate: case binds observations to the selected PR head SHA
metrics.actionable_message_rate: each non-PASS result contains Reason, Impact, named Target, one executable Next, and Severity
metrics.diagnosis_specificity_rate: primary problem names a concrete check, file, workflow, or configuration
metrics.incremental_finding_rate: AOS names a material gap absent from the frozen GitHub-native and required-checks-only baselines
metrics.business_relevance_proxy_rate: independent public review or maintainer action aligns with security, reliability, data-loss, API-contract, release, or required-control risk
metrics.historical_action_alignment_rate: AOS primary reason directly or strongly aligns with an independently observed human review action
metrics.noise_proxy_rate: evidence shows the warning was expected, irrelevant to the change, already covered, or required no maintainer decision
metrics.time_to_diagnosis_seconds: wall-clock time from command start to complete diagnosis
metrics.github_contrast_rate: AOS and GitHub-native baseline differ for an explained, evidence-backed reason

stopping_rule: Evaluate every eligible matched pair. Do not stop after favorable results. Fewer than four completed pairs yields INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE.
verdict_rule: This exploratory benchmark may yield WORKFLOW_UTILITY_SIGNAL, NO_CLEAR_WORKFLOW_UTILITY, or INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE. It cannot yield PRODUCT_USEFUL, production readiness, or a commercial GO.
